The decline reflects a shift in sentiment following recent gains fueled by OPEC+ production cuts.

Funding will be provided through a combination of German state aid and EU subsidies under the Chips Act. documents.title: European Regulators Approve Long-Acting HIV Prevention Treatment
documents.body: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) has granted approval for Cablivi, a novel injectable medication designed to prevent HIV infection. Clinical trials demonstrated high efficacy with administration every eight weeks, offering a discreet alternative to daily oral PrEP. Rollout across European Union member states is anticipated to begin by mid-year, pending national implementation plans. Public health officials hope the treatment will significantly reduce new HIV infections.

documents.body: A previously unknown collection of poems and prose by Polish Romantic poet, Julian Ursyn Niemcewicz, has been unearthed at the Austrian National Library in Vienna. The manuscript, bound in faded leather, appears to date from the 1820s and contains works never before seen by scholars. Library officials confirmed the find occurred during a routine inventory of the institution’s extensive Slavic holdings. Experts are already hailing the discovery as potentially rewriting aspects of Niemcewicz’s literary legacy.
